scripts._comment_mobile: The trailing `--` is load-bearing. Without it, `npm run mobile -- --port 8082` is parsed by npm itself: npm eats `--port`, passes a bare `8082` on to `expo start`, and expo reads it as a project root and dies with 'Invalid project root'. With it, the arguments reach expo. APP_TARGET works the same way: `APP_TARGET=japa npm run mobile -- --port 8082` (set it in the shell, not after `--`, because it is read by app.config.ts and not by expo's CLI).
scripts._comment_theme_audit: The item-19 dark-mode test, applied to every screen file at once: each route is opened in both colorSchemes and the screen's own colours must move. Writes PNGs to %TEMP%/theme-audit and exits 1 on a screen that did not.
scripts._comment_check_game: The two gates above are about the store listing. This one is about the game: it loads apps/mobile/lib/block-clear.ts in plain Node and asserts the rules, so it runs anywhere — the screenshot probes need Playwright and a preview, and those only exist on the capture VM.
